look_here_first: Look past the yellow flowers and feel the leaves: this is a rhizomatous perennial with conspicuously rugose or wrinkled leaves, hairy stems, and plume-like yellow inflorescences.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: rhizomatous perennial; conspicuously rugose or wrinkled leaves; hairy stems; plume-like branching yellow inflorescences

key_traits.label: Comparison training
key_traits.text: Leaf texture and stem pubescence are more useful than generic goldenrod flower color.

lookalikes.differences: Wrinkled leaf surface + hairy stems + plume-like inflorescence are the first-pass combination; confirm against local Solidago comparisons.
